items.event: Nitto ATP Finals, Turin: semi-finals and final
items.line: Sinner is out with a knee injury, so the title is open. No. 1 Zverev is already into the semis. Alcaraz beat Medvedev 6-2 6-4 and is one result away from joining him. Semis are Sat 22:30 JST and Sun 04:30 JST; the final is Mon 02:00 JST.

items.event: DP World Tour Championship, Dubai: McIlroy wins eighth Race to Dubai
items.line: Tyrrell Hatton won the finale by five shots. Rory McIlroy took solo second, which was just enough to beat Eugenio Chacarra in a desperately tight Race to Dubai. It is McIlroy's eighth season title, tying Colin Montgomerie's record.

items.event: The RSM Classic, Sea Island (PGA Tour FedExCup Fall finale)
items.line: This is the last PGA Tour event of 2026, and it decides who keeps a card for 2027. Ludvig Aberg makes his only fall start, Michael Brennan is the top-ranked player in the field, and Sami Valimaki is defending champion.
